3. Replace any bracketed placeholders (such as `{Dimension Name}`, `{Source Tables}`, or `{Context}`) with your specific project details.
4. Press Enter to generate SME-ready architecture documents, schemas, or pipelines.

### 2. Verbatim Prompt Template
```markdown
You are a senior data platform architect.

Create a comprehensive approach document covering:
• Landing Zone Architecture (ADLS / OneLake)
• File Format Strategy (Parquet, Delta, CSV, JSON)
• Batch vs Near-Real-Time Ingestion Design
• Provide very concise Comparison between different available options.
• Avoid providing code snippets
```
